# --instructions--

Add an initializer to `Circle` that takes a `Double` diameter without argument label and stores half of it in `radius`

Example of use:
```swift
print(Circle(10).radius)
// prints 5.0
```

# --before-seed--


# --seed--

# --asserts--

A diameter of `10` must give a radius of `5`

```swift
tryCatch(Circle(10).radius == 5)
```

A diameter of `3` must give a radius of `1.5`

```swift
tryCatch(Circle(3).radius == 1.5)
```

A diameter of `0` must give a radius of `0`

```swift
tryCatch(Circle(0).radius == 0)
```

# --solutions--

```swift
struct Circle {
    var radius: Double

    init(_ diameter: Double) {
        self.radius = diameter / 2
    }
}
```
